proves.claim: With submit.composeOnRunner on and submit.regenerateDeclared on, a submit with a stale declared generated file does not regenerate it and sends the builder head unchanged.

cli.io-submit-handoff-compose-on-runner..why: Without it, the command would regenerate in a tree the runner is about to compose again, and send a head the runner cannot reproduce.

proves.claim: With submit.composeOnRunner off, submit still regenerates a stale declared file and sends the regenerated head.

cli.io-submit-handoff-compose-on-runner..why: Without it, the compose-on-runner skip could leak into the default path and stop regenerating declared files for everyone.
